source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Use evidence-based practice only in academic settings and not when designing bedside protocols","B":"Treat research as separate from clinical care because studies do not guide nursing interventions","C":"Rely on unit tradition alone even when stronger current research supports a different approach","D":"Integrate current research evidence with clinical expertise when developing nursing protocols"}}
source_row.rationale: Incorporating current nursing research findings into clinical decision-making and protocol development reflects the value of evidence-based practice, helping ensure that nursing care and unit protocols are grounded in the most current, effective, and safe standards of care, rather than relying solely on tradition or personal experience.
source_row.source_detail: Evidence-based practice integrates current research evidence into clinical protocols and decisions; reviewed 2026-08-14.
source_row.source_name: Sigma Theta Tau International / AACN — Evidence-Based Practice in Nursing
